column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2288 runs two of the cleat#2285 shutdown scenarios (a: a run that finishes inside the grace; b: a call that outlives it and is released for another worker) on MySQL and SQL Server as well as PostgreSQL. Each subtest needs a live server of its dialect, so all four skip in this PostgreSQL-only job -- which sets CLEAT_CRASH_DB and nothing else -- and run in the crash-shutdown-dialects job in multi-db-ci.yml, where both DSNs are set. One skip per subtest, four in total; a registeredBackends-style helper costs two, this costs one each.
